saints.name: St. Augustine Zhao Rong and Companions
saints.title: Martyrs of China
saints.shortBlurb: A great company of Chinese Christians and foreign missionaries who died for the faith over three centuries…
biography: This memorial gathers together some one hundred and twenty martyrs who shed their blood in China between the seventeenth and twentieth centuries — Chinese laypeople, catechists, and clergy together with missionaries from Europe. Augustine Zhao Rong, whose name the group bears, was a Chinese soldier who, moved by the constancy of the Christians he had guarded, was baptized, became a priest, and died a martyr in 1815.

Many of the company perished during the persecutions of the nineteenth century and the Boxer Uprising of 1900. Beatified in earlier groups, they were canonized together by Pope John Paul II in the year 2000, on the solemnity of the Apostles Peter and Paul's octave.
saints.knownFor: The witness of the Chinese martyrs across three centuries.

sources.text: Vatican biography, Canonization of the Martyrs of China (vatican.va)
